summary: Native RemoveColor / English 'Remove Gems' must take gems off the board with no mana, no skull damage and no resources (unlike Destroy). Engine has only clear mode destroy|explode, so every 'remove' skill grants mana (e.g. troop:6970 L10: A1 mana+11 from 11 removed Blue gems). Needs a clear mode 'remove' (still counted by destroyedGems-style sources for 'boosted by Gems removed', still triggers cascades), then curated RemoveColor skills switch to it.
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:6970 -> 'destroy 11 (Blue x11) ... A1:mana+11'. Sources: community.gemsofwar.com/t/how-does-a-character-that-has-no-damaging-ability-hurt-me/1807 (destroying applies skulls/mana, removing only takes gems off the board); /t/reported-miswording-on-spell/82191 (destroy and remove are distinct game wordings); /t/how-do-you-use-gem-removers/16857 (removers do not generate mana).

summary: Native ConvertGems <Color> > Giant<Color> / Dragon<Color> (Giant / Dragon gems) has no SpecialGemKind; curated placeholder is transform <Color> -> <Color> (no-op), so 'Convert 5 Blue Gems to Blue Giant Gems' does nothing. Needs giant/dragon gem kinds (matchable as their colour, official on-match behaviour) and a transformToSpecial path; the curated rows then switch to it. Keep the damage / extra-turn counters on the step-0 CountGems value (count before the conversion).
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:7245 -> no convert event; prototype segment {op:'transform',from:'Blue',to:'Blue',count:5}. Damage (6 + 1.5 Magic + 2/Blue gem; 7440 family 6 + 2.5 Magic unboosted) and 10% + N/gem extra-turn chance already match native.

summary: tests/helpers/gowCast.ts shares status arrays between casts: DEFAULT_ALLIES[0].statuses and the DEFAULT_ENEMIES `ench` array (shared by E10 and E13) are passed by reference into damageCharacter, and status.ts applyStatus does char.statuses.push. A status applied in one cast leaks into every later cast in the same process (and E10 statuses also appear on E13). Golden lines therefore depend on which keys ran earlier in the process (approve batch, gowCastGolden replay order). Fix: clone statuses (and other nested arrays) per setupCast.
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:7749,troop:6047 -> 6047 shows 'remove A1 -barrier' and no devour (barrier leaked from 7749); show --keys troop:6047 alone -> 'dmg A1 504 devoured'. sa-F1 approves one key per process as a workaround.

summary: Sunbird native: Damage@Self 1, Damage@Self 10000, SummoningNoError 6387 = the caster really dies (death hooks, ally-death counters) and a fresh Sunbird (base stats, no statuses, 0 mana) is summoned. summonEffect resolves the side via findSide(casterId); once the killed caster is dropped from the roster it returns null and the summon is skipped. Needs summon to keep working after the caster died in the same cast (remember the caster side at cast start). Until then curated 7542 uses self-kill + selfRevive(full), which keeps statuses/buffs and skips death hooks.
repro: Replace selfRevive in batch-r26 7542 with summonRef('Sunbird', 6387): cast shows 'dmg C 10000 ; defeat C' and no summon event.

summary: targetChooser.ts prototypeChosenTargetMode scans only root segments; a chosen target used only inside oneOf (native Randomize) is never requested, so enemyChosen resolves to nothing and the whole spell has no effect. sa-F1 declared inputTarget (targetedSkill) on the 7 listed curated rows; the engine should also scan oneOf/choose options so every other Randomize skill with FromTarget works.
repro: Before the sa-F1 fix: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:6206 -> '(no spell events)' in all four scenarios. Grep curated for 'oneOf(' rows whose only enemyChosen/allyChosen targets are inside the branches.
